name: animacraft
description: The Fully Onchain Character Maker & Creator

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check chain-error-ui.js && node --check maker-commerce-v8.js && node --check maker-v8-actions.js && node --check maker-v8-browser.js && node --check maker-v8-chain.js && node --check maker-v8-compiler.js && node --check maker-v8-document.js && node --check maker-v8-market.js && node --check maker-v8-recovery.js && node --check maker-v8-runtime.js && npm test && npm run build
scripts.makers:verify: python3 -m py_compile scripts/chroma_key.py scripts/build-builtin-makers.py && node --test test/bundled-makers.test.js
scripts.move:build: for package in core seal runtime output physical market release; do sui move build --path move/animacraft_v8_$package --warnings-are-errors || exit 1; done
scripts.move:test: for package in core seal runtime output physical market release; do sui move test --path move/animacraft_v8_$package --warnings-are-errors || exit 1; done
scripts.move:probes: for package in core seal runtime output physical market release; do node move/animacraft_v8_$package/scripts/run_adversarial_probes.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.move:size: for package in core seal runtime output physical market release; do node move/animacraft_v8_$package/scripts/measure_package_size.mjs || exit 1; done
